meta.description: Official Mistral AI TypeScript SDK patterns — client setup, chat completions, streaming, function calling, structured outputs, embeddings, vision, Codestral FIM, and production best practices

copy.tagline: 用 TypeScript 调用 Mistral AI 的各类模型能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 TypeScript 开发 Mistral AI 应用
copy.tagline_en: Call Mistral AI models with TypeScript SDK patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building Mistral AI apps with TypeScript

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用 Mistral 官方 TypeScript SDK 来编写与 Mistral AI 模型交互的代码，包括聊天、流式输出、结构化输出、函数调用、嵌入、图像分析和代码补全。
howto.when: 当你要求编写或修改使用 Mistral 模型的 TypeScript 代码时触发，例如实现聊天、流式响应、结构化数据提取或代码补全。

say.text: 用 Mistral SDK 写一个流式聊天。
用 Zod 模式从文本中提取结构化数据。
用 Codestral 完成函数中间代码。
say.note: Claude 会使用 fim.complete() 方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the official Mistral TypeScript SDK to write code that interacts with Mistral AI models, including chat completions, streaming, structured outputs, function calling, embeddings, vision, and Codestral FIM.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write or modify TypeScript code that uses Mistral models, such as implementing chat, streaming, structured data extraction, or code completion.

say_en.text: Write a streaming chat using Mistral SDK.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code using chat.stream().

say_en.text: Extract structured data from text with Zod schema.
say_en.note: Claude will use chat.parse() with a Zod schema.

say_en.text: Complete a function body with Codestral FIM.
